title: InterventionLog (Protocol Qv Rev 7)
description: Immutable intervention log. Annotated to map to ISO 42001 §8.7 and NIST AI RMF 600-1. Fields added for Quantum Verification Module (QVM) and energy metrics.

signature_hash.description: Signature of the log entry (human/system) — insurer-grade.

incident_report_id.description: If the decision relates to an Article 73/55 incident, include regulator incident_report_id (if available).

joules_per_verified_operation.description: Energy KPI: joules per verified op. (Compute-aware design note)

metadata.description: Free-form metadata for provenance (tool, version, run_id).
